description: Stamp a PNG signature image onto one or more PDF pages at given positions (fractions of the page, x and y measured from the top-left, width as a fraction of page width). The signature keeps its aspect ratio. Returns the signed PDF as base64.

data.description: Base64 bytes or a data URI. Decoded size is capped at 10 MB.

filename.description: File name, including the extension when you have one.

mimeType.description: MIME type when you know it.

pages.description: Pages to keep, such as 1-3,5. Blank keeps every page.

url.description: Public http or https URL. Private and local addresses are refused.

width.description: Signature width, as a fraction of page width.

x.description: Horizontal position from the left, as a fraction of page width.

y.description: Vertical position from the top, as a fraction of page height.

signature.description: The signature as a PNG image, base64 or a public URL.

title: Sign a PDF with a PNG signature
